title: Pretty But expected the full set not 1 sheet.
text: Pretty But expected the full set not 1 sheet.. This was supposed to be a set. At least that's what I was led to believe. It really upset me that I got a bottom sheet when I would have paid 4-5 bucks more for the set. I thought it was a set on sale. I'm keeping it instead of going through the trouble of sending it back. I dont know many people that buy just a bottom sheet.

description: Bring soft and cozy feel to your bed with our double brushed microfiber fitted sheet. Our fitted sheet is designed with your comfort in mind. Made of finest double brushed microfiber yarns, this sheet creates a new standard in softness and breath-ability that makes it really hard to get out of bed in the morning. Our fitted sheet is sure to fit mattresses up to 14 inches deep, it has all-around elastic.

Our sheet is skillfully manufactured with strong and durable fabric that maintains the overall brightness and shape of the sheet for years to come. The tight weave of microfiber cause liquids to bead up and sit on the surface of the fabric for a short time instead of soaking immediately. This makes it highly stain resistant.

Ordinary washers and dryers can be used for easy care and washing of this fitted bottom sheet. Hand or machine wash in hot or warm water with mild detergent is recommended. Washing at a high temperature makes the microfibers expand, releasing trapped dirt and micro particles. If you hand wash, use a soft bristled brush if necessary ¨C rinse thoroughly.  Air dry is best for drying since microfiber dries relatively quickly. However, if you plan to use the dryer, set it on low heat or no heat. This setting uses less quantity of water for laundering, less percentage of chemicals and consume less energy for drying. Besides this, it is preshrunk to avoid any shrinkage after washing.

Do not use fabric softeners as they clog the open spaces in microfiber making the fabric useless. Also, do not wash microfiber with terry towel or material that shed a lot of lint. Wash them separately or with material like jeans or t-shirt that do not shed lint.
